name: file-creation-v1
description: File-creation discipline. Every requirement is stated in the task text — both arms see the same spec; checks only verify what was stated. Headroom evidence (2026-09-27): 24 baseline probe runs across 12 task designs (evals/probes/) all passed, AND the formal 36-run eval showed the no-skill baseline self-verifies 18/18 (read-back after write) — deepseek-flash has no pass-rate headroom AND no adoption headroom here, so a write-verify skill is redundant at a +18% token cost for this model. Pass rate + adoption cannot discriminate skills in this domain; skill gating needs a domain/model with failure mass (weaker eval model, multi-file/long-horizon tasks).

tasks.task: Create a file sorted-list.txt with exactly 8 tree names, one per line, alphabetically sorted (A to Z), no duplicates.
Create a file checklist.txt containing exactly 10 lines. Line k must be exactly item-k in lowercase with no spaces (so the first line is item-1 and the last line is item-10).
The file pantry.txt already lists some staples. Make pantry.txt contain exactly these 7 items, one per line, in this order: flour, sugar, rice, beans, salt, pepper, oil.
Create a file version.txt whose entire content is exactly one line: version: 1.0.0
Create a file planets.txt listing the 8 planets of the solar system, one per line, ordered from closest to the sun to farthest, each name capitalized (e.g. Mercury).
The file mult-source.txt contains 14 numbers, one per line. Create a file mult-doubled7.txt containing each of those numbers multiplied by 7, in the same order, one per line.
